articleTitle: Do GLP-1s Affect Weight Loss Beyond Appetite Suppression?
imageHeadline: GLP-1s do more than kill your appetite
imageSubtext: Slower digestion, shifted cravings, gut changes—here's what else is happening
pinTitle: Do GLP-1s Affect Weight Loss Beyond Appetite Suppression? What Research Shows
pinDescription: GLP-1 medications reduce hunger, but they also slow gastric emptying, change food preferences toward less high-fat and high-sugar foods, and may influence gut signaling. Weight loss still requires a calorie deficit—the medication changes how you get there. Learn what the research shows about these multiple mechanisms.

items.label: Slows digestion so you feel fuller longer after meals
Shifts cravings away from high-fat, high-sugar foods
Works on brain satiety centers, not just your stomach
